_comment: Hand-verified stat modifiers for items the text extractor cannot read
correctly. Each entry records WHY it is needed so it can be re-audited
against the wiki later. 'mods' is merged over the parsed result;
'replace: true' discards the parsed mods entirely for that item.
Only add an entry after reading the item's Effects section. These are
the numbers the calculator will show, so a guess here is worse than a

Polyphemus.reason: Damage is stated only as the formula '(Damage + 4) * 2', which the text extractor cannot interpret. Fire rate multiplier parses fine on its own.

Cricket's Head.reason: Its x1.5 belongs to the non-stacking group with Magic Mushroom and Blood of the Martyr + Book of Belial: holding several still yields 1.5x total.

Magic Mushroom.reason: Same non-stacking 1.5x group as Cricket's Head. Also grants a heart container, which is not a tracked stat.

The Book of Belial.reason: The 1.5x damage it grants (and its combination with Blood of the Martyr) is part of the non-stacking group. Active item, effect is per-room rather than permanent.
